title: SceneAxi shared authoring-jobs fixture list (v1)
description: The one canonical list of authoring jobs both authoring-interface contracts (E1 source-first surface, E2 schema-driven command editor) must satisfy on identical terms. Consumers MUST use this list verbatim — no per-contract additions, removals, or reorderings. Behavioral semantics: docs/authoring-contracts.md. Transferred from factories-helpers#49; SceneAxi is the source of truth from sceneaxi#5 on.

transferredFrom.description: Origin ticket per the issue-transfer plan. Constant: the transfer happened once.

id.description: Stable job id, referenced by both contracts' acceptance suites.

jobSummary.description: What the author is trying to accomplish, interface-neutral — no E1/E2 verb or editor mechanics may leak in.

editClass.description: Shape of the edit the job exercises. Document formats and concrete paths are deliberately NOT fixed here — they belong to the document-model ticket (sceneaxi#9), not this contract.
